mapper.update: UPDATE shopwizard.tShpShipDirectPrint SD INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP ON OP.OrderNo = SD.OrderNo AND OP.OrderProdNo = SD.OrderProdNo AND OP.OrderState = '출고지시' SET SD.ShipPlace = #{shipPlace}, SD.RecverZipcode = REPLACE(SD.RecverZipcode, '--', '-'), SD.ChangeId = #{actorId}, SD.ChangeName = #{actorName}, SD.ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE SD.ShopCode = #{shopCode} AND SD.ShipCheckDate IS NULL

WHERE SD.ShopCode = #{shopCode} AND SD.ShipCheckDate IS NULL ORDER BY SD.OrderNo, SD.OrderProdNo, SD.OrderChangeNo

mapper.update: UPDATE shopwizard.tShpShipDirectPrint SD INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP ON OP.OrderNo = SD.OrderNo AND OP.OrderProdNo = SD.OrderProdNo AND OP.OrderState = '출고지시' SET SD.BundleYn = 0 WHERE SD.ShopCode = #{shopCode} AND SD.ShipCheckDate IS NULL AND IFNULL(SD.BundleYn, 0) <> 0

UPDATE shopwizard.tShpShipDirectPrint SD INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP ON OP.OrderNo = SD.OrderNo AND OP.OrderProdNo = SD.OrderProdNo AND OP.OrderState = '출고지시' INNER JOIN ( SELECT S2.ShipPlace AS ShipPlace, S2.RecverAddr AS RecverAddr, S2.RecverName AS RecverName FROM shopwizard.tShpShipDirectPrint S2 INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrderProd O2 ON O2.OrderNo = S2.OrderNo AND O2.OrderProdNo = S2.OrderProdNo AND O2.OrderState = '출고지시' WHERE S2.ShopCode = #{shopCode} AND S2.ShipCheckDate IS NULL GROUP BY S2.ShipPlace, S2.RecverAddr, S2.RecverName HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT S2.OrderNo) > 1 ) B ON B.RecverAddr = SD.RecverAddr AND B.RecverName = SD.RecverName AND B.ShipPlace <=> SD.ShipPlace SET SD.BundleYn = 1 WHERE SD.ShopCode = #{shopCode} AND SD.ShipCheckDate IS NULL

UPDATE shopwizard.tShpShipDirectPrint SD INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP ON OP.OrderNo = SD.OrderNo AND OP.OrderProdNo = SD.OrderProdNo AND OP.OrderState = '출고지시' INNER JOIN ( SELECT S2.RecverAddr AS RecverAddr, S2.RecverName AS RecverName, LEFT(CONCAT_WS('@@@', S2.RecverAddr, S2.RecverName, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(S2.ProdName, '-', S2.ProdQty) ORDER BY S2.ProdName, S2.OrderNo SEPARATOR '#')), 500) AS SortName FROM shopwizard.tShpShipDirectPrint S2 INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrderProd O2 ON O2.OrderNo = S2.OrderNo AND O2.OrderProdNo = S2.OrderProdNo AND O2.OrderState = '출고지시' WHERE S2.ShopCode = #{shopCode} AND S2.ShipCheckDate IS NULL GROUP BY S2.RecverAddr, S2.RecverName ) G ON G.RecverAddr = SD.RecverAddr AND G.RecverName = SD.RecverName SET SD.PrintSortName = G.SortName WHERE SD.ShopCode = #{shopCode} AND SD.ShipCheckDate IS NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP WHERE OP.ShopCode = #{shopCode} AND OP.OrderState = '지불완료') AS payCompleteCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP WHERE OP.ShopCode = #{shopCode} AND OP.OrderState = '지불완료' AND (OP.ProdCode IS NULL OR OP.ProdCode = '')) AS prodUnmatchedCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP WHERE OP.ShopCode = #{shopCode} AND OP.OrderState = '지불완료' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shopwizard.tOrdUpriceMatch UM WHERE UM.ProdName = IFNULL(OP.ProdName, '') AND UM.ItemName = IFNULL(OP.ItemName, ''))) AS upriceUnmatchedCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP WHERE OP.ShopCode = #{shopCode} AND OP.OrderState = '출고지시') AS issuedCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT SD.OrderNo, SD.OrderProdNo
WHERE SD.ShopCode = #{shopCode} AND SD.ShipCheckDate IS NULL) x) AS sheetLineCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT SD.OrderNo, SD.OrderProdNo
WHERE SD.ShopCode = #{shopCode} AND SD.ShipCheckDate IS NULL AND SD.ShipPlace IS NULL) y) AS unbuiltLineCnt
mapper.sql:
FROM shopwizard.tShpShipDirectPrint SD INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP ON OP.OrderNo = SD.OrderNo AND OP.OrderProdNo = SD.OrderProdNo INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrder O ON O.OrderNo = SD.OrderNo LEFT OUTER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpChnl Ch ON Ch.ChnlCode = SD.ChnlCode WHERE SD.ShopCode = #{shopCode}
AND SD.ShipCheckDate = #{confirmedAt} AND SD.ShipCheckDate IS NULL AND OP.OrderState = '출고지시'
mapper.select:
SELECT SD.OrderNo AS orderNo, SD.OrderProdNo AS orderProdNo, SD.OrderChangeNo AS orderChangeNo, SD.OrderType AS orderType, SD.ChnlOrderNo AS chnlOrderNo, CAST(O.OrderReciptDate AS CHAR) AS orderReciptDate, SD.OrderName AS orderName, SD.ProdCode AS prodCode, SD.ProdName AS prodName, SD.ItemName AS itemName, SD.ProdQty AS prodQty, SD.SalePrice AS salePrice, SD.NvPrice AS nvPrice, SD.BuyPrice AS buyPrice, SD.RecverName AS recverName, SD.RecverPhoneNo AS recverPhoneNo, SD.RecverMobileNo AS recverMobileNo, SD.RecverZipcode AS recverZipcode, SD.RecverAddr AS recverAddr, SD.OrderMemo AS orderMemo, SD.DeliMemo AS deliMemo, SD.DeliFeeAmt AS deliFeeAmt, SD.DeliFeeType AS deliFeeType, Ch.ChnlName AS chnlName, IFNULL(SD.BundleYn, 0) AS bundleYn, IFNULL(SD.ShipPlace, '기본출고지') AS shipPlace, SD.PrintSortName AS printSortName, SD.DealName AS dealName, SD.OrderProdName AS orderProdName
ORDER BY IFNULL(SD.ShipPlace, '기본출고지'), SD.PrintSortName, IFNULL(SD.BundleYn, 0) DESC, SD.RecverAddr, SD.RecverName, SD.ProdName, SD.OrderNo, SD.OrderProdNo, SD.OrderChangeNo LIMIT ${offset}, ${limit}

SELECT DISTINCT SD.OrderNo AS orderNo, SD.OrderProdNo AS orderProdNo
WHERE SD.ShopCode = #{shopCode} AND SD.ShipCheckDate IS NULL ORDER BY SD.OrderNo, SD.OrderProdNo LIMIT ${limit}
